title: AI that answers from YOUR docs
narration: I gave an AI my company's policy documents. Now watch it think.
A customer cancels catering two days before the event. What refund?
That answer needed reasoning across two policy rules. It got it right.
And it cites which document the answer came from.
Ask it something that is not in the docs, and it refuses to guess.
Forty lines of code. Scripts linked below.
demo_commands: ./askdocs.sh "Customer cancels catering 2 days before the event - what refund?"
